content: Our goal is to generate a ranked list of answers for a given Premise Question INLINEFORM0 by ranking the recognized Hypothesis Questions INLINEFORM1 . Based on the RQE experiments above (Section SECREF27 ), we selected Logistic Regression trained on the clinical-RQE dataset to recognize entailed questions and rank them with their classification scores.
